answer: As of March 2, 2026, Casey's latest reported quarter was fiscal Q2 2026 (three months ended October 31, 2025): diluted EPS of USD 5.53 (net income USD 206.3 million, EBITDA USD 410.1 million) [H02-E1][H02-E2].
